If your model gateway (or an intermediary proxy) keys rout"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"ing, caching, or auditing on a session header, the harness cannot send one by itself."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"This plugin closes that gap with the two official interception points composed together:"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- the **`llm/stream` waterfall** names the calls that are LLM calls and carries `options.sessionId`;"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"
- a **`globalThis.fetch` patch** adds the header, so every fetch-based adapter (`llm-deepseek`, `ll"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"m-pi-ai`, and any SDK whose transport bottoms out in global fetch) is covered without touching adapt"},{"id":"p8s4","text":", and any SDK whose transport bottoms out in global fetch) is covered without touching adapter code."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Context propagation uses `AsyncLocalStorage`: only fetches that happen inside an LLM call's stream a"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"re touched; unrelated fetches (web RPC, telemetry, tool traffic) pass through untouched. A header an"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"yone else already set is never overwritten (case-insensitive, per HTTP semantics). Unloading the plu"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"gin restores the original `fetch`."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Semantics of the value:"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"- default: `GenerateOptions.sessionId` of the call in flight, with the harness's `session-` branding"},{"id":"p11s2","text":" prefix stripped (a plain UUID is sent) — main-session turns, compaction/title helper calls, and in-"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"process subagent children each report **their own** session id (subagents get their own child sessio"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"n ids);
- `value` config: a fixed value for every call instead (sent verbatim, no prefix stripping);"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"
- calls with neither get no header."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Requires the `dsh` CLI and Node ≥ 22."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"### As a bundle (recommended)"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"This package is plain JavaScript with no build scripts, so the pnpm ≥ 10 build allowance is not need"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"ed. | `valu"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"e` | string | — | fixed value; unset = the harness session id of the call in flight |
| `toolEndpoin"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"ts` | string[] | `[]` | URL prefixes matched during tool execution. When non-empty, fetches inside a"},{"id":"p23s4","text":" `tools/execute` waterfall — e.g. a gateway web-search Messages API called from a tool — get the hea"},{"id":"p23s5","text":"der only when their URL starts with one of these prefixes; third-party tool targets (web_fetch of ar"},{"id":"p23s6","text":"bitrary pages, GitHub, MCP servers) stay untouched. Empty (default) keeps the upstream LLM-only inje"},{"id":"p23s7","text":"ction. |
| `overwriteHeaders` | string[] | `[]` | Header names this plugin may overwrite when they a"},{"id":"p23s8","text":"lready carry a value. Everything else keeps the "never overwrite" rule. Some official providers hard"},{"id":"p23s9","text":"-code placeholder values (e.g. `dsh-web-search-deepseek` sends `x-opencode-session: dsh-web-search`)"},{"id":"p23s10","text":", which gateways reject as missing; list the header here (`overwriteHeaders: [x-opencode-session]`) "},{"id":"p23s11","text":"so the live session id replaces that placeholder. Case-insensitive. |"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## Verify it"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"Point a provider's `baseURL` at a logging gateway (or any endpoint that echoes request headers) and "},{"id":"p25s2","text":"'s `baseURL` at a logging gateway (or any endpoint that echoes request headers) and start a session:"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"Every request of the same conversation carries the same id; a spawned subagent's requests carry the "},{"id":"p27s2","text":"the same conversation carries the same id; a spawned subagent's requests carry the child session id."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"## Notes"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"- The `llm-deepseek` adapter already sends its own `x-deepseek-harness-session-id` on every request;"},{"id":"p29s2","text":" this plugin is provider-neutral and intentional about not overwriting existing headers.
- `attribut"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"ionHeaders()` (the harness User-Agent attribution contract) is never touched.
- Concurrent sessions "},{"id":"p29s4","text":"are handled correctly: the header value is resolved per call through AsyncLocalStorage, not through "},{"id":"p29s5","text":"shared mutable state."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"MIT"}],"truncated":false}
